departments.description: Oversees global talent acquisition, people operations, employee relations, workplace culture, compensation and benefits administration, and workforce compliance across all Threshold Enterprise Systems offices.
primary_responsibilities: Global talent acquisition, onboarding, and offboarding workflows
Employee relations, grievance resolution, and workplace culture programs
Compensation benchmarking, payroll administration, and benefits management
Performance management frameworks and professional development programs
Workforce regulatory compliance, equal opportunity, and workplace safety

departments.description: Responsible for core software engineering, distributed systems architecture, cloud infrastructure, platform scalability, DevOps, API development, and enterprise software products.
primary_responsibilities: Designing and maintaining distributed software architecture and microservices
Continuous integration, automated deployment pipelines, and release engineering
Cloud infrastructure provisioning, cost governance, and multi-region resilience
Software quality assurance, automated testing, and developer tooling
Technical debt management and engineering standard operating procedures

departments.description: Drives machine learning research, data platform engineering, large language model integration, predictive analytics, enterprise data pipelines, and intelligent retrieval system development.
primary_responsibilities: Developing and deploying enterprise machine learning and generative AI models
Designing data lakes, streaming pipelines, and distributed data warehouse architectures
Establishing data lineage, cataloging, hygiene, and feature store standards
Researching model safety, hallucination mitigation, and retrieval augmentation strategies
Collaborating on AI model evaluation, benchmarking, and observability

departments.description: Protects enterprise digital assets, customer data, and AI systems through threat intelligence, zero-trust architecture, vulnerability management, security operations, and incident response.
primary_responsibilities: Implementing zero-trust access control, identity federation, and credential security
Threat modeling, penetration testing, and continuous vulnerability scanning
Security incident response orchestration, digital forensics, and threat containment
Security compliance auditing against ISO 27001, SOC 2, and regional mandates
AI system security, adversarial prompt defense, and data exfiltration prevention

departments.description: Manages global business operations, IT service management (ITSM), cloud infrastructure reliability, vendor procurement, facilities, and business continuity planning.
primary_responsibilities: Overseeing 24/7 global service availability, uptime monitoring, and SLA compliance
Incident management, root cause analysis, and post-mortem review coordination
IT service desk workflows, asset management, and end-user hardware provisioning
Vendor relationship management, procurement processes, and contract renewals
Disaster recovery planning, business continuity drills, and physical facility operations

departments.description: Manages corporate financial planning and analysis (FP&A), global tax compliance, corporate accounting, treasury operations, enterprise budgeting, and cloud unit economics.
primary_responsibilities: Corporate financial planning, budgeting forecasts, and departmental allocation
Statutory accounting, financial reporting, and external audit coordination
Enterprise cloud FinOps, cost attribution, and capital expenditure governance
Global payroll financing, tax compliance, and currency risk management
Procurement financial approval gates and enterprise vendor contract review

departments.description: Establishes enterprise-wide corporate governance, AI ethics frameworks, regulatory compliance oversight, enterprise risk management, and legal policy adherence across all operating regions.
primary_responsibilities: Defining enterprise AI ethics, algorithmic transparency, and responsible AI policies
Regulatory compliance monitoring across India, US, UK, and Singapore jurisdictions
Enterprise risk register maintenance, audit trail oversight, and board reporting
Corporate data privacy governance aligning with GDPR, CCPA, and DPDP frameworks
Cross-departmental policy ratification, lifecycle management, and enforcement
